name: tripoli-wadis
_comment: Tripoli wadis pilot (#59). bbox is WGS84 [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]; covers the coastal strip from Janzour to Tajoura and the inland Jefara catchments draining to the city; bbox extended south to 31.85 and east to 13.65 (2026-10-24) so the full Wadi Al-Majenin catchment toward Gharyan fits. Buffer added before clipping so basins are not truncated.

dem._sha256_comment: Pinned SHA-256 of each tile .tif, computed from the AWS copernicus-dem-30m bucket on 2026-10-23 (N32) and 2026-10-24 (N31). download_dem.py refuses any file that does not match.

_outlets_comment: CONFIRMED outlets (confirmed by Abdullah, 2026-10-24; 400 m snap): coastal mouths / urban crossings. To change, adjust lon/lat then rerun. Pour points are snapped to the highest flow-accumulation cell within snap_distance_m.
